name: Toudou Tomomi
source:
A scientist hoping to study Seiichiro's uniquely regressive DNA qualities. She sends girls to him to make pregnant but doesn't get involved herself. Because she was created using her own egg cell [url=https://vndb.org/c7779]Tamami[/url] is her biological daughter.

Her 'favorite number' is 25
